title: The sprint review confirms a provisional answer only after the fresh-context reviewer has read the work it allowed
goal: kb-sprint review gives each provisional answer to the fresh-context reviewer with the diff it allowed, then asks the operator for its confirmation after the reviewer's report, so a gap in it becomes a changed answer, not a later draft (SP-5i4itd2d retrospective: BG-wcdbq563 gate g1, extend four committed pool checks by hand, was confirmed at step 1 before the step-4 reviewer found that the BP-df64045a extension accepts a non-answer, BG-i7q4cjpb)

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','when does the review confirm a provisional answer relative to the reviewer report','--budget','300'],capture_output=True,text=True);o=r.stdout;h=o.splitlines()[0] if o else '';print(h or r.stderr[:200]);sys.exit(r.returncode or int(not h.startswith('coverage: good (tested question')))

import sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t.split('## review SP',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];a=s.find('--confirm');b=s.find('fresh-context reviewer');print('first confirm at',a,'reviewer at',b);sys.exit(0 if 0<=b<a else 1)

options: confirm step after the reviewer's report; the brief lists each provisional answer with the diff of the commits that carry it
confirm step after the reviewer's report; the brief holds only the sprint diff
